evidence_slice: North Tyneside Council's official Local Plan consultation feedback page identifies the Initial Draft Local Plan consultation as running from 14 January to 25 February 2026 and, under developer and landowner responses, lists '(4000A) North of Killingworth Way' together with a location plan using the same site reference. The public ArcGIS REST services directory used by North Tyneside planning data lists a FeatureServer named 'NT Housing Sites Initial Draft 2026'. The Council's current Publication Draft Local Plan page confirms that the plan has advanced to the final consultation stage and includes proposed housing sites, but this batch does not infer that site 4000A remains in the Publication Draft; it captures the exact Initial Draft possible-site record.
